solutions.title: Direction walk
solutions.strategy: Walk one cell at a time, turning right when the next cell is out of bounds or already filled.

timeComplexity.explanation: Every matrix cell is filled once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Ignoring the output matrix, only coordinates and direction are stored.

solutions.title: Layer boundaries
solutions.strategy: Fill the current top row, right column, bottom row, and left column, then shrink the boundaries.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each cell belongs to exactly one boundary segment.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only boundary pointers and the next value are stored besides the output.
